1.consolidated_definition: Fingir. Dar a entender lo que no es cierto o aparentar lo que no es real. Desvío semántico, frecuente. DRAE 2001: querer ser o hacer diligencias para conseguir algo. Pretende que se siente como en casa mientras no la miro (Pepa Gracía, blog, 21-02-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To feign. To give the impression that something is not true or to appear as if something is not real. Semantic deviation, frequent. DRAE 2001: to wish to be or make efforts to obtain something. He pretends to feel at home as long as I don't look (Pepa Gracía, blog, 21-02-08)
